arguments.command:
rm -f scratch/fault.db; PYTHONPATH=app python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
from adapters import SqliteLedger
p='scratch/fault.db'
l=SqliteLedger(p)
l.seed()
l.close()
db=sqlite3.connect(p)
db.execute("""CREATE TRIGGER fail_receipt BEFORE UPDATE OF transfer_id ON payments
WHEN NEW.transfer_id IS NOT NULL
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'database or disk is full'); END;""")
db.commit(); db.close()
PY
python3 -B app/main.py --db scratch/fault.db --payment-id milestone-42 --destination acct_demo_contractor --cents 50000 --now 1788706800 --fixture app/fixtures/success.json >scratch/repro.stdout 2>scratch/repro.stderr; status=$?; echo status=$status; cat scratch/repro.stderr; echo '--- db'; sqlite3 -header -column scratch/fault.db 'select * from balances; select * from payments; select * from postings;'
